title: Living your best life as a mental health professional

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能赚到超越“用时间换金钱”的收益，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个激动人心的好消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现在已经开放报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己曾在2022年参加过这个项目，此后也一直支持两批心理学家走过他们的心路历程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的额外福利以及我提供的专属支持套餐，且无需额外付费。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 其中包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场小组智囊会、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特南&梅森礼品，以及限时一对一教练指导福利。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 请通过简介中链接我的福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, then let this be your guide.
sentences.zh: 如果你想成为一名心理学家，那就让这成为你的指南吧。

sentences.en: With this podcast at your side, you'll be on your way to the Aspiring Psychologist podcast with Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 有了这个播客陪伴在侧，你将踏上由玛丽安·特伦特博士主持的《有志心理学家》播客之旅。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎收听《有志心理学家》播客。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent, and I'm a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，我是一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: Now, if you are a regular listener or watcher, you might notice that A, the sound doesn't sound quite as good as it usually does.
sentences.zh: 现在，如果你是常客听众或观众，你可能会注意到，A，声音听起来不像平时那么好。

sentences.en: And B, if you are watching on YouTube, you might notice that I'm in a different location.
sentences.zh: B，如果你在YouTube上观看，你可能会注意到我在一个不同的地方。

sentences.en: Guilty as charged on both counts.
sentences.zh: 这两点我都供认不讳。

sentences.en: And actually, I'm probably doing the opposite of what I'm going to tell you to do in this episode.
sentences.zh: 而且事实上，我做的事情可能跟我在这期节目中要告诉你们的完全相反。

sentences.en: So, this episode is all about living your best life as an aspiring psychologist or a mental health professional.
sentences.zh: 所以，本期节目全部关于如何作为一名有志心理学家或心理健康专业人士过上最精彩的生活。

sentences.en: Because it's really important that we do in order to help us to manage the ebb and flow and the hustle and bustle and the kind of take-take nature that our jobs can feel like.
sentences.zh: 因为这真的很重要，我们需要这样做来帮助自己应对生活的起伏、忙碌喧嚣，以及工作常常带给我们的那种不断索取的本质。

sentences.en: So, I am on tour currently.
sentences.zh: 所以，我目前正在巡回中。

sentences.en: I am on holiday.
sentences.zh: 我在度假。

sentences.en: It's October half-term.
sentences.zh: 现在是十月的期中假期。

sentences.en: And I am, I'd say, living some of my best life here, really.
sentences.zh: 而且我可以说，在这里我真的过着非常精彩的生活。

sentences.en: So, where is here exactly?
sentences.zh: 那么，这里到底是哪里呢？

sentences.en: And if you're on YouTube, shall I show you where here is?
sentences.zh: 如果你在YouTube上收看，要不要我给你看看这里是哪里？

sentences.en: So, if you're listening, and even if you're watching, what I'm doing is I'm showing you the estuary view from this window, from the office window, which is just wonderful.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你在收听，甚至如果你在观看，我正在做的是向你展示从这个窗户、从办公室窗户看出去的河口景色，简直美妙极了。

sentences.en: I will level with you that this is the second time I've recorded this podcast episode.
sentences.zh: 我向你坦白，这是我第二次录制这期播客节目。

sentences.en: So, for some reason, the microphone wasn't working, and when I came to edit it, it had no sound, and a podcast with no sound is many things, but it's not a podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 所以，不知为什么，麦克风刚才没有工作，当我准备剪辑时，它没有声音，一个没有声音的播客可以有很多东西，但它不是播客。

sentences.en: And unless you're really good at lip reading, you're not going to get very much from that at all.
sentences.zh: 而且除非你真的很擅长读唇语，否则你从那里根本得不到太多东西。

sentences.en: So, when I was recording it earlier, there was a wind surfer out there distracting me in the most joyful of ways.
sentences.zh: 所以，当我刚才录制时，外面有一个帆板爱好者在那里以最快乐的方式分散我的注意力。

sentences.en: A slightly less joyful distraction is that in the house next door they're having a refurb, and so if you can hear banging and clanging, that is what that is.
sentences.zh: 一个稍微没那么欢乐的分心因素是，隔壁房子正在装修，所以如果你能听到敲敲打打的声音，那就是这个原因。

sentences.en: So, yes, why am I doing the episode today?
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我为什么今天要录制这期节目呢？

sentences.en: So, the episode kind of came to me because I just had a great day yesterday, really great.
sentences.zh: 所以，这期节目的灵感算是自然而然冒出来的，因为我昨天度过了非常棒的一天，真的很棒。

sentences.en: And I was just out and about on a kayak with my husband in the afternoon.
sentences.zh: 下午我和我丈夫划着皮划艇在外面闲逛。

sentences.en: So, a really lovely time.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是一段非常美好的时光。

sentences.en: It was a beautifully sunny day, and just really making me reflect on the last time I'd been on a kayak with him, which was, I think, in 2010.
sentences.zh: 那是一个阳光明媚的日子，真的让我回想起上一次和他一起划皮划艇是什么时候，我想大概是在2010年。

sentences.en: It's been a long time, you know, when you've got young children, it's kind of hard to kayak, but we left them home with the grandparents yesterday.
sentences.zh: 已经过去很久了，你知道的，当你有了幼儿时，划皮划艇是很难做到的，但我们昨天把他们留在家里的祖父母身边了。

sentences.en: And so, yeah, they were happy playing Roblox, whatever it is they were doing, whilst we were out kayaking about and about.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，他们在家开心地玩着Roblox，或者无论他们在做什么，而我们在外面到处划皮划艇。

sentences.en: So, we are on holiday this week.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们这周在度假。

sentences.en: We are in Muddyford in, where is it, Christchurch in Dorset.
sentences.zh: 我们在多塞特郡基督城的穆迪福德。

sentences.en: And it's lovely.
sentences.zh: 这里非常可爱。

sentences.en: As we were walking today, I saw a sign that said something along the lines of Christchurch, where time is pleasant.
sentences.zh: 当我们今天散步时，我看到一块牌子，上面写着类似于“基督城，时间过得很惬意”之类的话。

sentences.en: And I and my husband were like, time is pleasant.
sentences.zh: 我和我丈夫当时就在想：“时间过得很惬意？”

sentences.en: Is pleasant really a word that we use when things are really, really good, or is it when things are, like, fine?
sentences.zh: “惬意”真的是我们在事情真的、真的很棒时会用的词吗？还是说，当事情只是“还行”的时候才会用？

sentences.en: But, yes, if I, I was trying to decide whether if I lived here, and this was the view from my window, whether I'd be super, super productive,
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，如果我……我一直在纠结，如果我住在这里，这就是我窗外的风景，我会不会变得超级超级高产，

sentences.en: because I'd always want to sit at my desk, or whether I would just end up laying down on the sofa with a similarly glorious view and not get very much done at all.
sentences.zh: 因为我总想坐在书桌前，还是说我最终只会躺在沙发上，欣赏着同样壮丽的景色，却什么也干不成。

sentences.en: So, as I do sit here, I think, oh, if I wrote a book here, it would be just a lovely, lovely view.
sentences.zh: 所以，当我坐在这里时，我想，哦，如果我在这里写本书，这窗外的景色可真是太美太美了。

sentences.en: So, when I was writing the Aspiring Psychologist Collective and doing the editing for that, I went away for a weekend with my friends.
sentences.zh: 所以，当我编写《有志心理学家集体》并进行编辑时，我曾和朋友们一起出去度周末。

sentences.en: And before they arrived, I sat and overlooked the most beautiful Malvern Hills view, and that was really inspiring.
sentences.zh: 在他们到达之前，我坐在那里，俯瞰着马尔文山最美丽的景色，那真的非常鼓舞人心。

sentences.en: So, I'm all about the view, and that's one of my top tips, really, is, you know, if you are feeling a bit bogged down by life and the views around you,
sentences.zh: 所以，我非常看重风景，这其实也是我的顶级建议之一，你知道的，如果你觉得生活和身边的风景让你感到有些压抑，

sentences.en: then could you get out and about to even have a day of looking at something a little bit more awe-inspiring?
sentences.zh: 那么你能不能出去走走，哪怕花一天时间去看一些更能激发敬畏之情的东西呢？

sentences.en: So, I wrote a piece for the media a while ago that suggested that when we're seeing and experiencing awe-inducing things, that we have a better quality of life.
sentences.zh: 因此，我前段时间为媒体写过一篇文章，指出当我们看到并体验到能引发敬畏的事物时，我们会拥有更高质量的生活。

sentences.en: So, where could you look in your life to even have low-cost awe?
sentences.zh: 那么，在你的生活中，你可以在哪里寻找甚至低成本的敬畏感呢？

sentences.en: So, it might be going to a forest, you know, with really big, tall trees, where you can kind of just appreciate the difference in size
sentences.zh: 所以，这可能是去一片森林，你知道的，那里有非常巨大、高耸的树木，你可以在那里欣赏到体型上的差异，

sentences.en: and how long it would have taken for those trees to grow so tall.
sentences.zh: 以及这些树木长得这么高需要花多长时间。

sentences.en: Or it might be going out to see some water, you know, big, strong winds today.
sentences.zh: 或者这可能是出去看水，你知道的，今天风很大很强劲。

sentences.en: I definitely wouldn't have been kayaking today, although my little boy did want to go kayaking.
sentences.zh: 我今天绝对不会去划皮划艇，尽管我的小儿子确实想去划皮划艇。

sentences.en: And we thought it was just not quite that safe.
sentences.zh: 而我们觉得这实在是不太安全。

sentences.en: Oh, you'll be pleased to know our favourite windsurfer is back.
sentences.zh: 哦，你们会高兴地知道，我们最喜欢的帆板运动员又回来了。

sentences.en: Let me see if I can show you.
sentences.zh: 让我看看我能不能给你们展示一下。

sentences.en: There he is.
sentences.zh: 他就在那儿。

sentences.en: So, you obviously took a little bit of a break.
sentences.zh: 所以，你显然休息了一小会儿。

sentences.en: Maybe you want to have some hot chocolate and warmed up.
sentences.zh: 也许你想喝点热巧克力暖和一下。

sentences.en: Another lovely, comforting thing that you can also do.
sentences.zh: 这是另一件你可以做的可爱且慰藉人心的事。

sentences.en: So, for those of you listening, what I'm doing is I'm showing a lovely man on his white and blue water.
sentences.zh: 所以，对于你们这些收听者来说，我正在做的是向你们展示一个可爱的男人在白蓝相间的水面上。

sentences.en: A water, what is it?
sentences.zh: 水上，这是什么？

sentences.en: A water surfer, is it?
sentences.zh: 水上冲浪者吗？

sentences.en: A wind surfer, wind surfer.
sentences.zh: 帆板运动员，帆板运动员。

sentences.en: So, as he whips about now, I'm sure he will distract me in the most wonderful of ways.
sentences.zh: 所以，当他现在飞驰而过时，我相信他会以最美妙的方式分散我的注意力。

sentences.en: But yeah, I went wind surfing in 2010.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，我在2010年去玩过帆板。

sentences.en: It was very, very difficult.
sentences.zh: 那非常、非常难。

sentences.en: I went on one of those Nielsen holidays.
sentences.zh: 我去参加了那种尼尔森度假村的旅行。

sentences.en: Had an absolutely brilliant time.
sentences.zh: 度过了一段绝对绝佳的时光。

sentences.en: So, that was when I was just about starting my third year of doctoral training.
sentences.zh: 那正是我刚开始第三年博士培训的时候。

sentences.en: So, yeah, very much recommend going out and doing some active things, if you can, to help you get through whatever you've got going on in your life now.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，非常推荐你出去做一些积极的活动，如果可以的话，来帮助你度过目前生活中正在经历的任何事情。

sentences.en: But it's really important that we are living some of our best life, ideally.
sentences.zh: 但极其重要的是，理想情况下，我们要过上最精彩的生活。

sentences.en: Even when we're waiting to kind of get to where you think might be the good stuff, where all the good stuff happens.
sentences.zh: 即使在我们等待到达那些你认为可能是好东西、所有美好事情发生的地方时。

sentences.en: We need to be enjoying life along the way, too.
sentences.zh: 我们也需要一路上都在享受生活。

sentences.en: So, one of my next top tips is when you get a new diary for the year.
sentences.zh: 所以，我的下一个顶级建议之一是，当你拿到这一年的新日程本时。

sentences.en: This is mine.
sentences.zh: 这是我的。

sentences.en: I favour an A4 diary, like lots of room.
sentences.zh: 我偏爱A4大小的日程本，有很大的空间。

sentences.en: Is to think about best case scenario.
sentences.zh: 那就是去思考最佳情况。

sentences.en: And if you could get all of your choice of annual leave, what would you want?
sentences.zh: 如果你能获得你选择的所有年假，你想要什么？

sentences.en: And make sure that you are, ideally, booking it if you're part of a team.
sentences.zh: 并确保你理想情况下正在预订它，如果你是一个团队的一部分。

sentences.en: Or if you are self-employed, like me, that you're just taking it out of there as not available for bookings.
sentences.zh: 或者如果你像我一样是自雇人士，你只是把它从日程中划掉，标为不可预约。

sentences.en: Because it's really, really nice, actually, when you are doing client work and you're looking for the next available appointment.
sentences.zh: 因为当你做客户工作并寻找下一个可用预约时，这其实真的、真的很棒。

sentences.en: And then you flick past, you know, annual leave.
sentences.zh: 然后你翻过年假页面。

sentences.en: And you think, oh, yes.
sentences.zh: 你会想，哦，是的。

sentences.en: Oh, I have got that thing coming up.
sentences.zh: 哦，我那件事要来了。

sentences.en: Oh, brilliant.
sentences.zh: 哦，太棒了。

sentences.en: So, I tend to put all of my social things into my work diary as well.
sentences.zh: 所以，我倾向于把所有的社交活动也放进我的工作日程本里。

sentences.en: To give me like a little bit of a boost as well.
sentences.zh: 这也给了我一点精神上的鼓舞。

sentences.en: When I'm flicking through the diary, I think, oh, yeah, that thing's coming up.
sentences.zh: 当我翻阅日程本时，我想，哦，对了，那件事要来了。

sentences.en: Oh, I'm really looking forward to that.
sentences.zh: 哦，我真的很期待那个。

sentences.en: That would be really good to help bolster where you're at now.
sentences.zh: 这对于支撑你目前的现状真的会很有帮助。

sentences.en: So, yeah, that's something you might like to consider.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这是你可能会考虑的事情。

sentences.en: But it's really important to me as a parent that I'm having time with the children when they're on half-term breaks.
sentences.zh: 但对我作为一个父母来说，极其重要的是，当孩子们放期中假时，我要和孩子们在一起。

sentences.en: So, even before the half-term holidays and the school term dates get published, what I do is I am earmarking those.
sentences.zh: 所以，甚至在期中假期和学校学期日期公布之前，我要做的事就是把它们预先标记出来。

sentences.en: I'm looking on the local government website to look for the term times and making sure that where possible,
sentences.zh: 我会在当地政府网站上查找学期时间，并确保在可能的情况下，

sentences.en: I book out as much time as I can to be off with the children during half-terMs.
sentences.zh: 我尽可能多地腾出时间，在期中假期里和孩子们一起休假。

sentences.en: So, that I can have a good break.
sentences.zh: 这样我才能好好休息一下。

sentences.en: Sorry about the noise next door.
sentences.zh: 对不起，隔壁的噪音有点吵。

sentences.en: So, that I can decompress.
sentences.zh: 这样我才能减压。

sentences.en: You know, because we carry a heavy load in the work that we do.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，因为在我们做的工作中，我们背负着沉重的负担。

sentences.en: And so, making sure that we're able to maximise our time off is really key.
sentences.zh: 因此，确保我们能够最大化我们的休假时间真的是关键。

sentences.en: And, of course, we don't always want to be away from home.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们并不总是想离家外出。

sentences.en: Sometimes it's nice just to have downtime to be at home, to enjoy, you know, this space that you've created, you know,
sentences.zh: 有时，能在家里享受闲暇时光也很不错，去享受你所创造的这个空间，你知道的，

sentences.en: and have a little bit of R&R from right where you sit and right where you live.
sentences.zh: 就在你坐着和生活的地方进行一点休整（R&R）。

sentences.en: So, it's not all about rushing out and spending money, but it's about having time to just relax and to do the things you like to do.
sentences.zh: 所以，这并不全是关于匆忙出门花钱，而是关于有时间去放松并做你喜欢做的事。

sentences.en: Might that be naps?
sentences.zh: 这可能是小睡吗？

sentences.en: Could be.
sentences.zh: 有可能。

sentences.en: I absolutely used to love a nap.
sentences.zh: 我以前绝对超级喜欢小睡。

sentences.en: Or just to go out for walks in your local area or a little bit further afield.
sentences.zh: 或者只是去你当地或稍远一点的地方散步。

sentences.en: You know, you could head to the seaside for a day and have fish and chips.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你可以去海边呆上一天，吃炸鱼薯条。

sentences.en: You know, small pleasures can be very richly rewarding indeed.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，小小的快乐确实可以带来丰厚的回报。

sentences.en: So, don't think that life is suddenly going to become glorious when you're qualified.
sentences.zh: 所以，不要以为等你拿到资格证后生活就会突然变得辉煌灿烂。

sentences.en: You know, we need to be working hard to create a life that you're enjoying along the way.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们需要努力去创造一种你一路上都在享受的生活。

sentences.en: And then, of course, we hope that the same continues when you are qualified.
sentences.zh: 然后，当然，我们希望当你取得资格后，这种情况能继续下去。

sentences.en: I'm trying my best to dodge the incredibly noisy noises, but if it goes on for much longer, I might just need to plough on through regardless.
sentences.zh: 我正尽我最大努力躲避这些令人难以置信的嘈杂噪音，但如果它再持续下去，我可能不管三七二十一也要硬着头皮录下去了。

sentences.en: So, yeah, as I said before, this is the second time I've recorded this.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，正如我之前所说，这是我第二次录制这个。

sentences.en: And so, I think the light is probably more favorable now.
sentences.zh: 所以，我想现在的光线可能更合适一些。

sentences.en: It was a little bit sunny earlier.
sentences.zh: 刚才有点太晴朗了。

sentences.en: It was in my eyes.
sentences.zh: 光线直射进我的眼睛。

sentences.en: But it might mean that we have a slightly shorter podcast episode as well because I've done it all already.
sentences.zh: 但这可能也意味着我们这期播客节目会稍微短一点，因为我已经全部录完了。

sentences.en: I know where I'm going to go and also quite keen to go and sit downstairs and have a cup of tea.
sentences.zh: 我知道我要去哪里，而且也很想下楼去坐坐喝杯茶。

sentences.en: So, yeah, get your diary, fill it in, request the leave, you know, and if you're part of a team, it might well mean that you've got to negotiate what you're going to have.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，拿到你的日程本，填好它，申请休假，你知道的，如果你是一个团队的一部分，这很可能意味着你必须协商你的假期安排。

sentences.en: But it's really important that we're not just, you know, saving all our leave until the end of the leave year.
sentences.zh: 但极其重要的是，我们不能只是，你知道的，把所有的假期都攒到假期年底才休。

sentences.en: Often in the NHS, that will run until the end of March, beginning of April.
sentences.zh: 在NHS（英国国家医疗服务体系），这通常会持续到三月底、四月初。

sentences.en: But we don't want you to be having, you know, just lots of fallow time in the new year.
sentences.zh: 但我们不希望你在新的一年里，你知道的，有大量闲置的时间。

sentences.en: It's important to try and spread out that leave as much as you can.
sentences.zh: 尽量把假期分散开来，这一点非常重要。

sentences.en: And I know that bank holidays are likely pro-rated and they certainly were when I was in the NHS.
sentences.zh: 我知道银行假日（公众假期）可能是按比例折算的，我在NHS时确实也是这样。

sentences.en: But please use your leave, not just in one go.
sentences.zh: 但请把你的假期用起来，不要一次性全用完。

sentences.en: Please try to make sure that you're using it to enrich your life, your soul, your spirit, everything about you so that you're not just totally burned out all the time.
sentences.zh: 请尽量确保你用它来丰富你的生活、你的灵魂、你的精神、你的一切，这样你就不会一直处于彻底精疲力竭的状态。

sentences.en: And we need to think about the power of evenings and weekends and holiday as well.
sentences.zh: 我们需要考虑夜晚、周末以及假期的力量。

sentences.en: So, it's where I'm being a bad girl because I'm working on my holiday,
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是我表现得像个坏女孩的地方，因为我在假期里工作，

sentences.en: but I'm choosing to work on my holiday because it matters to me that you guys have a new podcast episode to look forward to each week as well.
sentences.zh: 但我选择在假期工作，因为对我来说重要的是，你们大家每周也能期待一期新的播客节目。

sentences.en: Because I know that many of you have this as part of your weekly routine.
sentences.zh: 因为我知道你们很多人把这当作每周例行公事的一部分。

sentences.en: And thank you from the bottom of my heart if that does describe you.
sentences.zh: 如果这确实形容了你，我从心底里感谢你。

sentences.en: So, yeah, using your evenings and weekends.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，利用好你的夜晚和周末。

sentences.en: And when I first got together with my husband, he was like, why don't you have more hobbies?
sentences.zh: 当我刚和我丈夫在一起时，他总是说，你为什么不多一点爱好？

sentences.en: Why do you not do more things?
sentences.zh: 你为什么不多做点事情？

sentences.en: And I was like, well, I like a bit of pilates.
sentences.zh: 我说，嗯，我喜欢普拉提。

sentences.en: I like chatting with my friends.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢和朋友聊天。

sentences.en: I like going out for dinner.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢出去吃晚餐。

sentences.en: I like naps.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢小睡。

sentences.en: Naps are a key hobby.
sentences.zh: 小睡是一项核心爱好。

sentences.en: And if you are lucky enough to still have naps in your life, perhaps you don't yet have children or you have some magical method of ignoring them so that you can nap,
sentences.zh: 如果你足够幸运，生活中还能有小睡，也许你还没有孩子，或者你有什么神奇的方法可以忽略他们以便你可以小睡片刻，

sentences.en: please let me know.
sentences.zh: 请告诉我。

sentences.en: Tag me when you've had a really good nap, won't you?
sentences.zh: 等你睡了个真正的好觉后记得艾特我，好吗？

sentences.en: Come and talk to me about your naps on the Aspiring Psychologist community on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 来 Facebook 的“有抱负的心理学家”社群跟我聊聊你的小睡吧。

sentences.en: Yeah, I love a good nap.
sentences.zh: 对啊，我很喜欢睡个好觉。

sentences.en: I love a good nap.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢睡个好觉。

sentences.en: My in-laws are currently asleep right now.
sentences.zh: 我的公公婆婆现在正在睡觉。

sentences.en: On the sofa downstairs because they've come away with us.
sentences.zh: 在楼下的沙发上，因为他们跟我们一起出来玩了。

sentences.en: That was noisy.
sentences.zh: 刚才好吵。

sentences.en: That was noisy.
sentences.zh: 刚才好吵。

sentences.en: That's not them snoring.
sentences.zh: 那不是他们在打呼噜。

sentences.en: That's not them snoring.
sentences.zh: 那不是他们在打呼噜。

sentences.en: That is the work people next door.
sentences.zh: 那是隔壁工人在干活。

sentences.en: So, yeah, try to make sure that you've got things to look forward to in your evenings and weekends, but don't over-quam them.
sentences.zh: 所以，对，尽量确保你的晚间和周末有期待的事情，但别把它们塞得太满。

sentences.en: Just because there's a gap in your social calendar doesn't mean you need to fill it.
sentences.zh: 社交日程上有空档并不意味着你非得把它填满。

sentences.en: So, I'm trying to adopt the concept of not booking more than two things over a week to do because they'll just be burned out, you know?
sentences.zh: 所以，我正在尝试采纳这样一个理念：一周下来不要预订超过两项活动，因为你会筋疲力尽的，你知道的？

sentences.en: And it's tricky to do anyway because the children seem to relentlessly have football, I was going to say football rehearsal,
sentences.zh: 而且这本来就很棘手，因为孩子们似乎总是有没完没了的足球，我是说足球排练，

sentences.en: football practice and training and actual matches and stuff.
sentences.zh: 足球练习、训练以及真正的比赛之类的。

sentences.en: So, yeah, gone are the days where my weekends are my own anyway.
sentences.zh: 所以，对，我的周末完全由自己做主的时代已经一去不复返了。

sentences.en: But, yeah, I was really just – I enjoy my work, you know?
sentences.zh: 不过，对，我其实只是——我很享受我的工作，你知道吗？

sentences.en: And I did as an aspiring psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我作为一名有抱负的心理学家时也是如此。

sentences.en: So, if you're not really enjoying your work as an aspiring psychologist, it might be an idea to reflect on how different you envisage qualified life to be when you get there.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你作为一名有抱负的心理学家并没有真正享受你的工作，或许可以反思一下，当你真正达成目标时，你想象中的合格生活会有多大不同。

sentences.en: Because, in my experience, they're not vastly different.
sentences.zh: 因为根据我的经验，它们并没有太大的不同。

sentences.en: You know, I do more media now.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我现在做更多媒体方面的事情。

sentences.en: I do, obviously, write books and things and I do podcasts.
sentences.zh: 我当然会写书之类的，我还会做播客。

sentences.en: But my day-to-day work isn't that different, really.
sentences.zh: 但我的日常工作其实并没有那么大不同。

sentences.en: And so, yeah, think about where you might be able to crank up the joy,
sentences.zh: 所以，对，想想你在哪里可以提升快乐感，

sentences.en: perhaps using supervision to think about creating more opportunities within your work to do the things that you really, really do enjoy might be useful.
sentences.zh: 也许利用督导来思考如何在工作中创造更多机会去做那些你真正、真正享受的事情，这会很有用。

sentences.en: So, what we're going to do is we're going to take a short break here and I'll be back along very soon.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们接下来要做的是在这里稍事休息，我很快就会回来。

sentences.en: My name is Diakolola Amujam.
sentences.zh: 我的名字是迪亚科洛拉·阿穆贾姆。

sentences.en: I am a recent psychology graduate from Ireland.
sentences.zh: 我是来自爱尔兰的应届心理学毕业生。

sentences.en: I am also an aspiring clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我这也是一名有抱负的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: Dr. Marion's book, The Clinical Psychologist Collective, has been so helpful to me on this journey to becoming a clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 玛丽安博士的书《临床心理学家集锦》在我成为临床心理学家的这段旅程中给予了我极大的帮助。

sentences.en: As I plan to continue postgraduate studies in the UK, I found it extremely useful that this book provided in-depth information on the UK declinesite application process.
sentences.zh: 由于我计划在英国继续攻读研究生，我发现这本书提供了有关英国临床心理学博士申请流程的深入信息，这极其有用。

sentences.en: I enjoyed reading about the experiences of both qualified and training clinical psychologists.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢阅读合格的临床心理学家和正在接受培训的临床心理学家的经历。

sentences.en: The various narratives were my favourite part of the book, as everyone's story was different and it provided amazing insights into the clinical psychology journey.
sentences.zh: 各种各样的故事是我最喜欢的部分，因为每个人的故事都不同，它为临床心理学之旅提供了奇妙的见解。

sentences.en: I would definitely recommend this book to anyone interested in psychology and aspires to become a clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我绝对会把这本书推荐给任何对心理学感兴趣并立志成为临床心理学家的人。

sentences.en: Coming back to me, I hope you found this first half useful so far.
sentences.zh: 回到我这里，希望大家觉得前半部分目前对你们有所帮助。

sentences.en: So, yeah, in the first half, we were thinking about the blank diary and the power of evenings and weekends.
sentences.zh: 所以，对，在前半部分中，我们讨论了空白的日程表以及晚间和周末的力量。

sentences.en: I was also chatting to somebody today, actually,
sentences.zh: 其实今天我也跟某个人聊过，

sentences.en: who's gone straight from being an aspiring psychologist and working really long hours with zero downtime and zero annual leave to go straight to doctoral training.
sentences.zh: 他刚刚从一名有抱负的心理学家、需要工作极长时间且零休息时间和零年假的状态，直接过渡到了博士培训。

sentences.en: And finding that after teaching block and kind of hustling to form cohort relationships and expectations from the university, as well as new placement expectations and pressures,
sentences.zh: 然后发现，在经历了一段教学期、为了建立同伴关系和适应大学期望而四处奔波之后，还要面对新的实习期望和压力，

sentences.en: both self-imposed and supervisor imposed, finding they're feeling a bit burned out already, which is really, really tricky.
sentences.zh: 既有自我施加的，也有督导施加的，他发现自己已经感到有点精疲力竭了，这真的非常棘手。

sentences.en: And so I really do advocate using your diary to think, well, if I were to get on to doctoral training this year, what could my summer look like?
sentences.zh: 所以我真的很主张利用你的日程表来思考：嗯，如果我今年能进入博士培训，我的夏天会是什么样的？

sentences.en: What could I afford to, how long could I afford to potentially not work for?
sentences.zh: 我能承担得起、潜在可能有多长时间可以不用工作？

sentences.en: Or could I use some of my annual leave to take before I finish to make sure I have a really enjoyable break?
sentences.zh: 或者我可以在结束前用掉一些年假来休假，以确保我能有一个非常愉快的假期？

sentences.en: So when I started training, as you might know already, because I talk about it quite a lot, I'd had just the most wonderful summer.
sentences.zh: 所以当我开始培训时，正如你们可能已经知道的那样，因为我经常谈到它，我度过了一个最美好的夏天。

sentences.en: I'd been away backpacking with a friend in Spain and Morocco.
sentences.zh: 我曾和一位朋友在西班牙和摩洛哥背包旅行。

sentences.en: And then I came back and finished off my work in the service I was working in and then went away to India for five weeks, too.
sentences.zh: 然后我回来完成了我之前工作的那个服务机构的工作，接着又去印度待了五周。

sentences.en: And also, I seem to recall, I went to Barcelona with a very big group of assistant psychologists.
sentences.zh: 而且我还依稀记得，我和一大群助理心理学家去了巴塞罗那。

sentences.en: I think we already knew we were going to be on training at that point.
sentences.zh: 我想当时我们已经知道我们要去参加培训了。

sentences.en: And it was just such fun.
sentences.zh: 那可真是太有趣了。

sentences.en: I got mugged.
sentences.zh: 我被抢劫了。

sentences.en: But even then, on the other side of that, it was such fun.
sentences.zh: 但即便如此，抛开这些不谈，那还是相当有趣。

sentences.en: We had a great time.
sentences.zh: 我们度过了一段美好的时光。

sentences.en: And so it was just a really wonderful summer.
sentences.zh: 所以那真的是一个非常美好的夏天。

sentences.en: And so I really came to clinical training just energized, enthusiastic, tanned, happy, you know, living my best life.
sentences.zh: 因此，我来到临床培训时，可以说是充满活力、热情洋溢、晒得健康、开心快乐，你知道的，过着我最好的生活。

sentences.en: I'm really excited for this next stage.
sentences.zh: 我为接下来的阶段感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: So, yeah, where could you imagine or hope or dream that you might spend this summer if this is your summer before you go on to doctoral training?
sentences.zh: 所以，对，如果这是你进入博士培训前的那个夏天，你能想象、希望或梦想你会在哪里度过这个夏天吗？

sentences.en: So, yeah, dare to dream.
sentences.zh: 所以，对，大胆去梦想吧。

sentences.en: And just before the first time I recorded this podcast episode, there's a book here just behind me called The Best Moment of Your Life.
sentences.zh: 就在我第一次录制这期播客节目之前，我身后的这里有一本书叫《你生命中最美好的时刻》。

sentences.en: And it's about, it's about, it's a hundred stories.
sentences.zh: 它讲的是，它讲的是，这是一百个故事。

sentences.en: It's a bit of a collective, actually.
sentences.zh: 其实有点像是一个合集。

sentences.en: A hundred stories written by people who have had, you know, really amazing moments.
sentences.zh: 由那些有过，你知道的，真正精彩时刻的人们所写的一百个故事。

sentences.en: And one of them, the first story is actually something that I've already done, which I thought was incredible.
sentences.zh: 其中一个，第一个故事其实是我已经做过的事情，我觉得这太不可思议了。

sentences.en: So I haven't had a chance to look through it, really.
sentences.zh: 所以其实我还没机会仔细翻阅它。

sentences.en: But it's about someone who went to Varanasi in India and lit these little candles and then put them out across the Ganges.
sentences.zh: 但它是关于某个人去印度的瓦拉纳西点燃了这些小蜡烛，然后把它们放在恒河上漂流。

sentences.en: And you do that with kind of mindful hope, a connection to people that you've loved and lost and for your hopes and dreams in the future.
sentences.zh: 你带着某种正念的希望、与你所爱却失去的人的联系以及对未来希望和梦想的寄托去做这件事。

sentences.en: And so I've done that.
sentences.zh: 所以我也做过这件事。

sentences.en: And it was really, it was like a really nice spiritual thing to do.
sentences.zh: 这真的很棒，就像是一件非常美好的精神层面的事情。

sentences.en: So that was really nice.
sentences.zh: 所以那真的很美好。

sentences.en: That made me reflect upon some of the other really lovely things I've done as well, like going to Australia and driving around the world's largest sand island,
sentences.zh: 这让我回想起我做过的其他一些非常美好的事情，比如去澳大利亚，环游世界上最大的沙岛——

sentences.en: which is Fraser Island.
sentences.zh: 也就是弗雷泽岛。

sentences.en: And, you know, encouraging the dingoes not to steal our barbecue and hitching a tent and sleeping out there and sleeping under the stars in the Thar Desert.
sentences.zh: 还有，你知道的，阻止澳洲野狗偷我们的烧烤，搭帐篷露宿，在塔尔沙漠的星空下睡觉。

sentences.en: And riding a camel, which I talk about in the Aspiring Psychologist Collective book.
sentences.zh: 还有骑骆驼，我在《有抱负的心理学家集锦》这本书里提到过。

sentences.en: And what other things?
sentences.zh: 还有什么呢？

sentences.en: Hanging out in Thailand and swimming with dusky dolphins in New Zealand.
sentences.zh: 在泰国闲逛，在新西兰和暗色斑纹海豚一起游泳。

sentences.en: And all of these were, you know, things that I've done whilst being an aspiring psychologist, you know.
sentences.zh: 这些全都是，你知道的，我在作为一名有抱负的心理学家期间做过的事情，你知道的。

sentences.en: So in chunks of time that I've taken to go out there and see the world, but also nourish my soul, you know.
sentences.zh: 所以，这些是我抽出的时间，用来出去看世界，同时也滋养我的心灵，你知道的。

sentences.en: And actually, I don't know if I'd be here without doing that because on the days that are tricky, I've very much drawn on many of those experiences.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我不知道如果没有这样做我是否还能站在这里，因为在那些艰难的日子里，我非常大地汲取了其中许多经历的力量。

sentences.en: So how could you do the things that nourish your soul?
sentences.zh: 那么，你该如何做那些能滋养你心灵的事情呢？

sentences.en: You know, that might be dancing, it might be singing, it might be traveling,
sentences.zh: 你知道，那可能是跳舞，可能是唱歌，可能是旅行，

sentences.en: it might be eating great food or cooking great food or spending time with people you really enjoy spending time with.
sentences.zh: 可能是品尝美食、烹饪美食，或者与你真正喜欢陪伴的人共度时光。

sentences.en: So how can you look to do that?
sentences.zh: 所以，你该如何着手去做到这一点呢？

sentences.en: Because all work and no play makes life not feel very enriching.
sentences.zh: 因为只有工作没有玩耍会让人觉得生活索然无味。

sentences.en: So, yeah, that was a loud noise.
sentences.zh: 所以，对，刚才那是很大的声音。

sentences.en: How can you do that as well?
sentences.zh: 你又该如何做到这一点呢？

sentences.en: And we need to make sure we're looking forward to things.
sentences.zh: 我们需要确保自己对某些事情有所期待。

sentences.en: So having things to look forward to.
sentences.zh: 也就是要有值得期待的事情。

sentences.en: So, for example, comedy gigs, maybe.
sentences.zh: 所以，比如，去看喜剧演出。

sentences.en: I was supposed to be going to John Richardson tomorrow, but we had to cancel because it had originally been scheduled for the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 我本打算明天去看约翰·理查森的演出，但我们不得不取消了，因为它原本是为疫情期间安排的。

sentences.en: And then it had been rolled forward and moved to a date I couldn't do, so we had to refund it, which was a shame.
sentences.zh: 后来它被顺延并改到了一个我无法出席的日期，所以我们不得不退票了，这真是一件憾事。

sentences.en: But, yeah, I might well look to think what other comedy gigs I can get booked in, trips to see friends, meals in restaurants I'd like to go to, you know,
sentences.zh: 不过，对，我可能还是会考虑还能预订什么其他喜剧演出，去拜访朋友的旅行，去我想去的餐厅吃饭，你知道的，

sentences.en: family I might like to catch up with.
sentences.zh: 叙旧的家人。

sentences.en: I've got a shopping trip with a couple of different friends, university friends and psychology undergraduate friends.
sentences.zh: 我要和几个不同的朋友去购物，大学朋友和心理学本科朋友。

sentences.en: And, yeah, so what can you do that might enrich your life and help decompress, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以，对，你能做些什么来丰富你的生活并帮助自己减压，你知道的，

sentences.en: take off some of the pressure from this pressure cooker of life that we get when we are working as a mental health profession or any kind of role where you're supporting and caring about others.
sentences.zh: 减轻生活中这种高压锅般的压力——当我们作为心理健康专业人士或从事任何支持和关怀他人角色的工作时，这种压力就会产生。

sentences.en: And along those lines, I would say it's really important to use supervision as well.
sentences.zh: 顺着这个思路，我认为充分利用督导也是非常重要的。

sentences.en: And we can use supervision to look forward as well and to think about when you, you know, where you might like to go, you know.
sentences.zh: 我们可以利用督导来展望未来，思考当你，你知道的，未来想去哪里，你知道的。

sentences.en: And we can also use any yearly appraisal to think about what experiences you might like to have to, you know,
sentences.zh: 我们还可以利用任何年度考核来思考你可能想获得哪些经历，来，你知道的，

sentences.en: shape you and direct you and point you in the direction that you want to go.
sentences.zh: 塑造你、指引你，并把你带向你想去的方向。

sentences.en: So don't be afraid to say that you're not thinking this is going to be your forever job, you know, it's absolutely OK to want to go to different places.
sentences.zh: 所以不要害怕说你并不认为这是一份会干一辈子的工作，你知道的，想要去不同的地方是完全可以的。

sentences.en: So perhaps you want to be a senior PWP or a senior assistant psychologist, or perhaps you want to get your first kind of assistant psychologist role, for example,
sentences.zh: 所以也许你想成为一名高级 PWP（心理福利从业者）或高级助理心理学家，或者也许你想获得你的第一份助理心理学家职位，比如，

sentences.en: or research assistant role.
sentences.zh: 或者研究助理职位。

sentences.en: And I would say I hope you're in an environment where you're able to be honest about that and they can help support you to get to this next step of the rung of the ladder,
sentences.zh: 我想说，我希望你身处一个能够让你对此坦诚相待的环境中，他们可以帮助支持你迈向阶梯的下一步，

sentences.en: which is going to be so useful for you.
sentences.zh: 这对你将大有裨益。

sentences.en: So this is a slightly brief episode than it was originally.
sentences.zh: 所以这期节目比原本的要稍微简短一些。

sentences.en: I think we came in about 29 minutes before, but there was more distraction available with more windsurfing discussion opportunities.
sentences.zh: 我想之前大约是 29 分钟，但当时有更多关于风力冲浪讨论机会的分心内容。

sentences.en: We've had more of a focus.
sentences.zh: 我们现在的重点更集中了。

sentences.en: The last episode was a little bit, a little bit woolly and a little bit too relaxed.
sentences.zh: 上一期节目稍微有点，稍微有点漫无边际，也稍微有点太放松了。

sentences.en: Whereas now I was slightly annoyed when I started this because I can't believe I filmed an entire podcast and there was no sound and I checked it and everything.
sentences.zh: 而现在我刚开始录制时有点生气，因为我简直不敢相信我录完了一整期播客却完全没有声音，而我之前明明检查过所有东西。

sentences.en: But yes, I came and did a redo.
sentences.zh: 不过是的，我又来重新录了一遍。

sentences.en: And if there's no sound this time, then frankly, you're just going to have to listen to no sound and to try and work out what I was saying.
sentences.zh: 如果这次还是没有声音，那坦白说，你们就只能听着寂静，然后努力猜我刚才到底在说什么了。

sentences.en: But yes, I've done away with the airpods and you might have slightly worse sound and also quite a lot of noise to put up with.
sentences.zh: 不过是的，我抛弃了 AirPods，你们听到的声音可能会稍微差一点，而且还要忍受相当多的噪音。

sentences.en: And you might be able to hear the buffeting wind as I sit here in this office room looking out at the wonderful estuary views.
sentences.zh: 你们可能还能听到呼呼的风声，因为我正坐在这个办公室的房间里，眺望着绝美的河口景色。

sentences.en: So yes, if you found this useful, then please come and discuss it with me on socials.
sentences.zh: 所以是的，如果你觉得这有用，请来社交平台上和我讨论。

sentences.en: Tell me about your naps as well.
sentences.zh: 也跟我讲讲你的小睡吧。

sentences.en: I'm very excited by naps, even when they're not my own.
sentences.zh: 我对小睡感到非常兴奋，哪怕不是我自己的小睡。

sentences.en: Yeah, and talk to me about your hobbies and your past terMs.
sentences.zh: 对，还有跟我聊聊你的爱好和过去的消遣。

sentences.en: Come and discuss it with me on the Aspiring Psychologist Community, brackets free group.
sentences.zh: 快来“有抱负的心理学家社群”（括号里是免费群）和我讨论吧。

sentences.en: That's on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 那是在 Facebook 上。

sentences.en: And yeah, if you would welcome some more support, then come along to the Aspiring Psychologist membership.
sentences.zh: 还有，对，如果你希望获得更多支持，那就来加入“有抱负的心理学家会员计划”吧。

sentences.en: Details in the show notes.
sentences.zh: 详细信息在节目文稿中。

sentences.en: And also the day this episode is released is Halloween, 31st of October.
sentences.zh: 并且，这期节目发布的日子也是万圣节，即 10 月 31 日。

sentences.en: And so we've got a live Q&A, compassionate Q&A across my socials as well.
sentences.zh: 因此我们在我的各大社交平台上也有一场直播问答，即充满同理心的问答。

sentences.en: Do bear in mind if you're joining on Twitter, I can't see your comments live.
sentences.zh: 请记住，如果你是通过 Twitter 参与的，我无法实时看到你的评论。

sentences.en: So perhaps come along, Dr Marianne Trent, most other places, but also on Facebook for Good Thinking Psychological Services too.
sentences.zh: 所以或许可以来玛丽安·特伦特博士的其他绝大多数平台，以及 Facebook 上的“美好思维心理服务”（Good Thinking Psychological Services）找我。

sentences.en: So yeah, come and see me.
sentences.zh: 所以，对，来找我吧。

sentences.en: Ask me questions.
sentences.zh: 向我提问。

sentences.en: Let me answer them for you.
sentences.zh: 让我来为你解答。

sentences.en: And bearing in mind there's a competition running until midnight on the 31st of October as well.
sentences.zh: 请记住，一直到 10 月 31 日午夜还有一场竞赛正在进行。

sentences.en: More details for how you can win a one-to-one with me are available to you at www.goodthinkingpsychology.co.uk forward slash my hyphen books.
sentences.zh: 关于如何赢得与我一对一咨询机会的更多详细信息，你可以访问 www.goodthinkingpsychology.co.uk 斜杠 my hyphen books 获取。

sentences.en: And you can see all the details there that you need to know.
sentences.zh: 你可以在那里看到你需要了解的所有详细信息。

sentences.en: But yes, thank you for joining me.
sentences.zh: 不过是的，谢谢你加入我。

sentences.en: I'm going to go and hope there's some sound on this episode.
sentences.zh: 我要去看看这期节目到底有没有声音了。

sentences.en: Maybe see if I can get a little bit of a glass of wine on the go, maybe.
sentences.zh: 也许看看能不能顺便搞一杯葡萄酒来喝喝。

sentences.en: It's a little bit of a random Wednesday afternoon off work.
sentences.zh: 这是一个有点随性的周三下午假。

sentences.en: And yeah, look forward to the fish and chips that we're having for tea tonight, which I seem to be aware I've got rather good reviews from the local GP.
sentences.zh: 还有，对，期待我们今晚茶歇要吃的炸鱼薯条，我好像听说它得到了当地全科医生的相当不错的评价。

sentences.en: So yes, I hope you found this useful.
sentences.zh: 所以是的，希望你觉得这有用。

sentences.en: I hope you found it inspiring.
sentences.zh: 希望你觉得这鼓舞人心。

sentences.en: Give yourself permission to allow yourself to do the things that make you smile and enrich your soul because it's going to be so important along the journey.
sentences.zh: 允许自己去做那些能让你微笑、滋养你心灵的事情，因为这在整个旅程中将是如此重要。

sentences.en: I hope you found it useful.
sentences.zh: 希望你觉得这有用。

sentences.en: Thank you for being part of my world.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你成为我世界的一部分。

sentences.en: And I'll look forward to catching up with you for our next episode, which is available to you from 6am on Monday.
sentences.zh: 我期待在我们的下一期节目中与你叙旧，该节目将于周一早上 6 点起向你提供。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你能赚取超越“用时间换金钱”的收入会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，一名临床心理学家，我自 2019 年以来一直在开发被动和经常性收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个令人兴奋的消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One to Money program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“One to Money”项目现在开放报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于 2022 年完成了该项目，此后也一直支持两批心理学家走过他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的推广链接加入，你将获得苏菲的赠品以及我独家的支持礼包，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 其中包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场群组头脑风暴、大师班、个性化指导、一份福南梅森礼品以及限时的一对一教练指导加成。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过简介中链接的我的赠品页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的赠品。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时在线。
